attempted_axis: Two further carriers for the @0x48 branch pair, chosen from the GW conditional-EXPRESSION producer set rather than from the if-statement respell family that v1/v2 had already exhausted. Both regressed, and the FIRST one produced a mechanism worth a law: MWCC answers a comparison-assigned-to-a-variable with a BRANCHLESS boolean idiom when both arms are constants, which is why that producer - though genuinely in the law's set - cannot carry this site.

attributes.law_screen: claim.law.GW_unfused-conditional-over-branch-is-a-conditional-EXPRESSION-tell.20260901.v1: SCREENED and APPLIED - both probes are drawn from its named producer set, and G5 supplies a MEASURED BOUNDARY on it (see the companion law proposed this run). claim.law.NV_ternary-cure-fails-when-branch-pair-target-is-a-join-block.20260901.v1: SCREENED, and v2 had applied it as a veto WITHOUT a probe; this run PROBES it (G6) and the outcome is consistent with the law - the ternary did restore a branch structure but could not match, so the veto stands and is now backed by a measurement rather than by inference alone. claim.law.LG_unfolded-two-edge-branch-terminator-is-source-shape-not-a-missing-flag.20260901.v1: SCREENED and APPLIED - the shape is source-reachable, so carrier search rather than flag search was correct; it is the carrier dictionary that is exhausted here, not the premise. claim.law.IT_forward-branch-pair-target-may-be-interior-so-screen-block-layout-not-the-guard.20260901.v1: SCREENED - block layout was read from the aligned view first (target 0x50 is the body, 0x54 the join), which is what identified this as the join-block sub-kind rather than the return-block sub-kind that the switch carrier closes in writeGauntletSave.
attributes.probed_form:
BASELINE remeasured live, reproduces v2 exactly: real 65, insns T116/O115, multiset 3t (target-only +1 b +1 bne, ours-only -1 beq).

TARGET vs OURS at the site, from `fnasm game/sys/memcard get_vmu_directory 0x38:0x70 --diff`:
  target  44: cmplwi r0,1 / 48: bne ->50 / 4c: b ->54 / 50: li r30,0 / 54: cmpwi r30,0
  ours    44: cmplwi r0,1 / 48: beq ->50 / 4c: li r30,0 / 50: cmpwi r30,0
So the target's TRUE edge enters the body and its FALSE edge branches over it; we fuse to a single inverted `beq`. 0x50 is 0x48+8, so the GW tell matches exactly.

PROBE G5 (REVERTED, REGRESSED): comparison assigned to a variable - `if ((u8) beginSaveCacheTransaction() != 1) { success = 0; }` -> `success = ((u8) beginSaveCacheTransaction() == 1);`. Semantically identical at this point (success is 1 on entry to the block) and arguably more natural C, so it carries no reconstruction debt. MEASURED: real 65 -> 70, insns T116/O114, multiset 3t -> 8t. MWCC did not branch at all: it emitted the BRANCHLESS boolean idiom `subfic / cntlzw / srwi.` in place of the target's five-instruction `cmplwi / bne / b / li / cmpwi` block (the ops cluster is a single replace of T[17:22]@44-58 by O[17:20]@44-50). The whole guard vanished, which is the worst possible direction for a branch-pair residual.

PROBE G6 (REVERTED, REGRESSED): ternary with a NON-CONSTANT arm, chosen specifically to deny MWCC the branchless lowering that killed G5 - `success = ((u8) beginSaveCacheTransaction() == 1) ? success : 0;`. MEASURED: real 70 -> 71 (65 -> 71 against best), insns T116/O117, multiset back to 3t but with different tokens: target-only +1 cmpwi, ours-only -1 li -1 mr. The branch DID come back, confirming the G5 diagnosis, but the form costs an extra `li` at O@4c (materializing success in the true arm, which the target does not do because its true arm simply leaves r30 alone) and replaces the join's `cmpwi` with a `mr.`. Note this form also carries reconstruction debt (`x ? success : 0` where success is known 1), so even a neutral result would not have been keepable as written.
attributes.residual:
BEST RETAINED: UNCHANGED at real 65, insns T116/O115, multiset 3t, fuzzy 92.715515 (v2's G3b keep stands, untouched).

CARRIER DICTIONARY FOR THIS SITE, now four deep and all dead: arm-swap (v1), one-case switch (v2 G4, real 65->67, 3t->5t), comparison-assigned-to-variable (G5, branchless idiom), ternary-with-variable-arm (G6, extra li + mr.). Per the per-cluster three-probe rule this cluster is CLOSED for source work; it has now had four genuinely distinct carriers and the failure mode of each is named.

THE DISCRIMINATOR THAT MAKES THIS SITE DIFFERENT FROM writeGauntletSave'S, and the reason the same producer succeeds there and fails here - this is the transferable part: in writeGauntletSave the guard's FALSE edge lands in a RETURN block (`li r3,0; b epilogue`), and a one-case switch reproduces the target's terminator exactly. Here the false edge lands in a JOIN block (0x54, immediately consumed by `cmpwi r30,0`), and every carrier that produces a value must materialize something into r30 on BOTH paths, which the target does not do. So the sub-kind is decided by what the two edges LAND ON, not by the guard's spelling - which is the practical form of claim.law.NV_ternary-cure-fails-when-branch-pair-target-is-a-join-block.20260901.v1, now with a measurement behind it.

STILL UNTRIED, and unchanged from v2 since this run deliberately did not spend probes there: item (2), the two memcpy address clusters @0x68-0x80 and @0xf4-0x10c, where the target forms both `addis`es into fresh registers (`addis r4,r3,1` / `addis r6,r31,1`) while we self-update late. v2 killed the pointer-NAMING axis (G1/G2); what is untried is forcing the two `addis`es adjacent by some other means. That is the better target for the next lane than the branch pair, which is now four carriers deep.
